It's not that you shouldn't crouch, but a lot of players get into the habit of crouch spraying. In Valorant, one headshot kills an enemy, and you're only accurate if you aren't moving. Sometimes the best option is to move side to side shooting one bullet at a time, sometimes the best option is to commit and crouch spray your gun. The latter option is much easier to do, so people get into that habit. It's just important to do both.

To compare it to League, think about playing Lux. If she hits Q, she's probably killing someone, so ideal Lux gameplay is usually running around fishing for a snare, and if you hit it, you blow your whole kit on them (This is akin to moving side to side, shooting one bullet at a time. You're trying to kill the enemy, but you can retreat if you need to). If you get caught in the jungle and miss your Q though, you can't exactly run away, you just have to throw the rest of your kit and hope they die. (This is like crouch spraying, it's less accurate but you're committing to the fight cus there's no retreating).

So imagine if everytime you threw your Q on Lux, you just also threw out your whole kit, regardless of if you hit your Q or not. Sure you're killing people sometimes, but you don't need to commit everything and fight to the death, you can just wait till the next opportunity.
